title: Characterization of AC
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ belongs to $\mathrm{AC}$ if and only if there is a natural number $i$ such that $L$ has a well-formed, polynomial-size circuit family whose depth is bounded by a polynomial in $\log n+1$ of degree $i$; the family recognizes exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
